Title: What is CLO-SET?
Content: CLO-SET is a Collaborative 3D Creation Workspace that maximizes the value of the 3D assets by bridging stages of the product life cycle in one centralized digital space. CLO-SET For Brands Manufacturers Individuals CLO-SET FAQ Creating an Account CLO-SET Pricing Plan

Title: Console - Statistics
Content: Permission: Group Admin, Group Operator Objective Access Admin Console by clicking icon on your CLO-SET dashboard. Admin Console shows the Group summary, Billing, Statistics, Activity Log, Settings, and Developer Page. On the Statistics tab, you may review details on your user activity and Content statistics. User Activity Content Statistics Details 1) User Activity 1. Select the measurement period you want to view. 2. You can search specific members with their registered name or email to view their usage. 3. Click on the field to sort - from highest or from lowest. The field you've chosen will be shown in skyblue. 2) Content Statistics Filter the Date &amp Workroom you want to view For Group Operators, the 'Space' filter will only display the list of Spaces to which they have Viewer or above permission to. Group Admin can select any Space within the Group. Total Style Contents: Total number of Contents uploaded during the date range, and included in the statistics shown below. This covers ONLY the Contents you have viewing permission to. Average Used Colors: Average number of Colors used per Style Content Total Fabric Colors: Total number of Fabric Color used within the selected Space *ONLY Applicable to any Content uploaded on March, 2023 and onward. 2. Total Color Composition Rate The Doughnut Chart on the left shows the distribution of Primary Colors used for the Style Contents. Hover over the Color to view the details. On the right hand table, click on each Primary Color to view all the related Original Colors. Primary Color: Main Color(Hex/Pantone) with the highest usage rate among similar color group Original Color: All unique Colors used. Grouped by Primary Color. *Color usage rate is calculated based on the fabric size 3. Trends Chart Trends Chart shows the number of Style Content that used the top 10 Primary Colors over time. You may view the Color Trend chronically. Change the chart type to Bar or Line, or change period to Week or Year to change the view. Bar Chart Line Chart 4. Scatter Chart Scatter Chart visualizes the Saturation/Brightness of the Colors used. Click on the Primary Color to view the Original Colors included in the group. X-axis: Hue (Color Spectrum of 0~360) Y-axis: Saturation or Brightness per your selection. Click on the upper left dropdown button to switch the view. Marker Size: Number of Style Contents that used the selected Color.

Title: Console - Billing
Content: Permission: Group Admin, Group Operator Objective Access Admin Console by clicking icon on your CLO-SET dashboard. Admin Console shows the Group summary, Billing, Statistics, Activity Log, Settings, and Developer Page. On the Billing tab, you may review details on your billing history, invoice, and user history. Billig History User History Details *This page lists the highest permission level for each group member. For more details on permission by space, visit 'Permission Management' tab within Admin Console. 1) Billing History Update Date (UTC/GMT): Reflects the User History the next day Date: Indicates User history (same as Invoice date / most recent dates are located at the top) Invoice No. Description: Indicates Subscribed plan + User history information The number of increase and decrease of the paying users will be calculated on daily basis and the number will be displayed in the Description/Credit column. Charges: Indicate additional charges (see below for pricing reference) Planned payment: ex) Billed $700.00 Accumulated credit: ex) Additional $60.00 will be billed Deducted credit: ex) Credited $66.67 Payment: When an actual transaction occurs(completion/cancellation), the transaction amount will appear in the payment column Credit balance: The accumulated credit balance becomes 0 every month after payment is completed Billing History &gt Invoice Group admin can view the invoice payment details from the Billing history page 2) User History Group admin can view the changes of all users type among the group (Only indicates a change of permission for billing, not for each space and style). For more information on permission by space, visit 'Permission Management' tab within Admin Console.

Title: Payment Process
Content: Objective Follow the below steps to start subscribing to CLO-SET Advanced Plan. Details 1. Go to https://style.clo-set.com/service/pricing 2. Click the button 3. Input your billing address including country, city, zip code, and address. 4. You can see the total amount for your order and the number of paying users. 5. Read and agree to Terms of Service and Privacy Policy. Then, click the button. 6. Input your additional information on the Stripe window. Then, click the 'PAY' button Stripe Payment Window may pop-up, When the Billing address is missing When the terms and conditions box is unchecked In case of card payment error (e.g. insufficient balance, etc.) 7. Now, your payment is completed and you are ready to start Advanced plan. *CLO-SET Advanced Plan is $50 per paying user, every 30 days. Paying users are: Admin, Collaborator, and Editor in your Group. Note (1) When you subscribe to the advanced plan you are on the Advanced plan trial, the remaining Trial period will be considered expired/terminated. (2) Automatic payment is scheduled every 30 days

Title: Annotation
Content: Objective Create an Annotation for a detailed feedback. Create/Edit Annotation Annotation Shortcut Download Annotations in PDF Copy Annotation to new Version Details 1) Create Annotation To add an Annotation, click icon in the upper right corner of 3D Viewer in Content page. 1) Select a Version: Annotation can be created on each Version. Select the desired Version first, and click on 'Annotation' icon at the top-right corner of the 3D Viewer. 2) Create Annotation: Use the toolbar on the right to create an Annotation. Once you're done, click 'Complete'. You will see a new Annotation has been created on the far right pane. Annotation Toolbar Comment (T) Click within the 3D viewer, write a comment, and click POST. Double-click to edit. Shortcuts: Bold (Ctrl + B) / Italic (Ctrl + I) /Underline (Ctrl + U) Image (I) You can attach an image file as annotation. Select (V) You can change the position of comment or drawing. Pencil (B) Line (L) Pen (P) Arrow (A) Arc (C) Rentangle (R) Create drawing and basic figures. Line Color (O) Line Width (W) You can set drawing color and thickness. 2) Annotation Shortcut All Functions Copy Ctrl + C Paste Ctrl + V Flip Horizontally Shift + H Flip Vertically Shift + V 3) Download Annotation in PDF Click on the Annotation icon on your right pane to view the list of Annotations. Next to each Annotation, you may click on icon to download the PDF. To download a PDF including all Annotations, click on 'PDF' button at the top right corner. 4) Copy Annotation to new Version From the latest version, click on 'Annotation' button on the right pane Click ''Get previous version of the Annotation' button Select the Annotations you'd like to bring to the new Version

Title: CLO-SET Thumbnail
Content: Content: Applicable to Content uploaded or updated on March 12th, 2024 and onward, or PDF files uploaded on July 9th, 2024 and onward. Objective Understand the Thumbnail types and rules in CLO-SET. Default Colorway Thumbnail Types &amp Rules Thumbnail Change PDF Thumbnail Details 1) Default Colorway CLO-SET Thumbnails are created based on the original file. Starting Mar 2024, CLO-SET thumbnails will be synced with the Default Colorway in CLO3D. 'Deafult Colorway' is the selected Colorway at the time of saving the file in CLO3D. To change the 'Deafult Colorway' used in CLO-SET, you may upload a new Version or 'Create New Version' 2) Thumbnail Types &amp Rules Content Page There are 3 types of Thumbnail images on the Content Page. [Important] Beginning March 2024, all Thumbnails within the Content Page will be based on the Default Colorway of the uploaded file. Workroom View [Important] Beginning March 2024, Workroom Thumbnail and Turntable will be based on the Default Colorway of the original file. Assortment [Important] Beginning March 2024, Assortment Thumbnail will be based on the Default Colorway of latest version at the time Content was moved to the Assortment. 3) Thumbnail Changes Change Thumbnail Thumbnail in Content Information tab Thumbnail in Workroom view Turntable will NOT be updated Version Update Uploading a new Version will auto-update the Thumbnails in Content Page and Workroom. To avoid the changes in Thumbnail, please activate 'Keep the current Thumbnail' option. Create New Version Creating a New Version will update all Thumbnails in Content Page &amp Workroom View. Selected Colorway at the time of creating the new Version will replace the 'Default Colorway' . Delete Latest Version Deleting the Latest Version will NOT update the Thumbnails shown in Workroom or Content Page - Information tab. Thumbnail from the deleted version will be displayed. To change the Thumbnail, please upload a new Version or Create New Version. 4) PDF Thumbnail When uploading a PDF file as a new Content or Version, CLO-SET will create a thumbnail based on the cover page of the uploaded PDF file. Users can click the 'PDF preview' button on the viewer to load the preview of the full document. If the 'keep current thumbnail' option is enabled, Thumbnail will not be updated on Content Info tab and Workroom page. If the file is too large or cannot be opened due to error, a PDF icon will be displayed instead. Content Page Thumbnail (PDF) Workroom Thumbnail (PDF)

Title: Color Preset
Content: Permission: Admin Collaborator Editor Objective Upload a Color Palette to be shared within your Company space. The Color Preset can be used in CLO-SET configurator. Adding Color Preset Using Color Preset Details 1) Adding Color Preset Group Admin, Company Admin only Upload the .aco/.ase file in Company Settings page. If you don't have access, please contact your Company Admin or Group Admin. 1. In your Company Space, click 'Settings' &gt 'Configurator' &gt Add Color Preset = 2. Upload the .ase/.aco file, type in the name and description. Then, save 'Click' *Maximum number of colors in the file is 2000. *Each Company can upload up to 3 preset files. ------------------------------- 3. To delete the Preset file, click the X icon in the upper right corner. Please note that the deleted Preset files are NOT stored in Trash. 2) Using Color Preset Admin/Collaborator/Editor 1. In Content Page, click 'Configurator' &gt Color &gt Custom tab. Select a swatch from the drop-down list. 2. From the Material List, select the Fabric/Pattern you'd like to change. Then, select a color. *Optional: Desaturate the fabric color from the 'Texture' Option to apply/see true-tone colors. (可选) 3. Go to 'Picker' to find similar Pantone colors or copy the color code. Go to 'Picker' tab 1. Information of selected color. 2. Find the color code. 3. Find similar Pantone colors. 4. Click 'Create' to add CLO-SET Colorway (). You may view the new Colorway from the 'Colorway' tab on the right pane. 5. When downloading, select the 'All Colorways' option to download a new .zprj including CLO-SET Created Colorways. 6. Create a new Version in CLO-SET including the new Colorway as part of the .zprj file. Find more on Version Creation here.

Title: Web Tech Pack ▶ BOM
Content: Permission: Admin Collaborator Editor Objective CLO-SET Web Tech Pack integrates your everyday tech pack with 3D Contents. Let us bring all the data from your 3D file into an auto-generated Tech Pack. Enjoy a tech pack that is always up-to-date. On the BOM tab, you can add/edit subsidiary materials and estimated cost critical for production. Colorway/Grade/Version Edit Material Detail Add Material Item Add/Delete Row Details 1)Colorway/Grade/Version You may view the BOM data per Colorway, Grade, and Content Version Colorway - You may create new Colorway from CLO/MD software Grade - You may create new Grades in CLO3D software Version - When you upload a new version of the Content on CLO-SET, you can choose to update WTP information accordingly. 2) Edit Material Detail Non-Editable: Content ID (if uploaded on CLO-SET) / Name / Color / Texture / Marker are extracted from your zprj/zpac file. Editable: Consumption / Unit Price / Total Price / Remark can be edited on WTP. This information will also be reflected on WTP - Cost Estimation tab Material information may be added/edited/deleted per Colorway/Grading/Version per your selection. 3) Add Material Item If needed, add Fabric and Trim materials by clicking the + button on your right. Please note that the Content Type must match the type of material you want to add. For example, to add a material under Fabric, the uploaded file must be in zfab format and identified as Fabric Content Type in CLO-SET. User must have 'Editor' or above permission to the Workroom to which the original Content (to be added as Material) is saved. *Content Type can be selected upon upload. You can not change/edit the Type after the upload. 4) Add/Delete Row You may delete/add rows on the BOM table. Right-click on the Row to either delete it or add new above/below the selected row.

Title: Functional usage measurement standard
Content: Objective Users will have usage limits on Embed Viewer, CLO-SET API, and Uploading functions. The usage limit is refreshed every 30days and the remaining usage balance will NOT be rolled over to the next month. 1. Embed Viewer 2. CLO-SET API 3. Uploading API 4. Render Details 1) Embed Viewer Embed view will be counted per number of clicks which consumer has viewed the items through the embed viewer from the customer's website The advanced group will have 10,000 view limits on embed viewer, while additional 1,000 views will be added per paying user in the group. Also, admin is counted as a single user. Therefore each group will be charged with 10,000 view(group) + 1,000 views(admin). View count is renewed/refreshed every 30 days. 2) CLO-SET API CLO-SET API will be counted per the number of styles which has been enabled from Publish Embed Viewer from CLO-SET A single advanced user group will have 10,000 view limits on CLO-SET API. View count is renewed/refreshed every 30 days. 3) Uploading API Uploading API will be counted per number of style uploads through CLO-SET API. The advanced group will have 1,000 API call limits on Uploading API. Upload count is renewed/refreshed every 30 days. 4) Render Free plan users have a rendering usage limit of up to 1GB. If the user is on Advanced or Trial, each user has a render usage limit of up to 3GB. Rendering usage is based on the Render output file size.

Title: Billing Guideline
Content: Objective Understand how CLO-SET Group Pricing works, as well as invoices and billing. Payment per Group Automatic Renewal Who are the Paying users? Daily added &amp Deleted user counting standard What is Credit? Refund Example: Your Billing History Explained Details 1. Payment per Group CLO-SET Pricing plan operates on a Group level. That is, each Group is using either Advanced, Free, or Trial. This pricing plan is applicable to all users within the Group. 2. Automatic Renewal Your subscription will be renewed every 30 days. The monthly payment amount for your subscription may vary based on the number of paying users within your Group. If you start your Advanced Plan subscription during your Trial period, the remaining Trial period will expire and considered terminated. 3. Who are the Paying Users? 'Paying User' includes any Admin, Collaborator, or Editor in your Group. Viewers are non-paying users and are not charged additionally. Find out more on Permissions HERE. To view or manage your Group's permissions, please visit Permission Management tab. 4. Adding/Deleting users during your subscription You may need to add additional team members to your Group after your subscription has begun. Additional User: Charged on the next billing cycle. Amount calculated on a daily basis. Each additional user will be charged $1.67 per day ($50/30 = $1.67). The amount will be recorded as Credit on your Group. Please see below for an example. Deleting User: If you delete a user during your billing cycle, the amount of unused days will be refunded in a form of Credit on your account ($1.67 per user for every used day). This additional Credit will automatically be used on your next payment. Please see below for an example. *If a user uses more than a single second during a day, we will count according to that as one used day. *User removal standard: If you remove users on January 1st, removed the user's used amount until January 1st will be calculated and reflected on your bill. *Plan usage period standard: Even if payment was completed at 11:59:59, we would still count as one used day. 5. What is Credit? Any changes on number of users within your Group will be reflected on your Group's Credit. All Credit Balance will be processed in your next payment. 6. Refund CLO-SET does not refund for plans that have already been paid. However, scheduled payment can be canceled in advance. 7. Example: Your Billing History Explained 1) Advanced plan start: Prepaid for 10 Paying users/30 days in black color 2) Add Paying user: Deduct credits with (-) sign in red color 3) Remove 2 Paying users: Accumulates credits in blue color for (2), (3) : It will not be charged immediately and it is calculated on a daily basis 4) Renewed the Advanced plan for December Total users increase/decrease(carryover balance)*: $20 + Renewed Paying users: 700$ = Total payment: $720 &amp Credit balance becomes 0

Title: CLO-SET Pricing Plan
Content: Objective Understand different Pricing Plans available in CLO-SET. Find more information on our Pricing Page. [Upcoming] CLO-SET Pricing Plan Renewal Plan Type Overview Advanced Plan Budgeting for your team 30-day Trial Free Plan Enterprise Plan Available features under each Plan Details 0) Upcoming: CLO-SET Pricing Plan Renewal CLO-SET Pricing Plan will be renewed starting November 5th, 2024. Find more information on the plan renewal HERE. 1) Plan Type Overview *Note: Current Pricing Plan is available until November 4th, 2024. Find more information on the plan renewal HERE. CLO-SET provides 3 different Plan Types, and a free Trial period for all new users. CLO-SET Pricing operates on a Group level: When the Group is subscribed to the Advanced plan, everyone in that Group will be able to use all CLO-SET features. Each individual user may be subject to different plan types under different Groups. Plan Type Feature Availability Recommended To Free Limited. See below for details. Advanced Full access to CLO-SET features. Enterprise &amp Individual groups of 5+ Enterprise Full access &amp Private Render Server &amp Additional Security Measures Enterprise Client with 100+ users *30-day Trial is offered to all new users. Trial Plan provides all features included in Advanced Plan. 2) Advanced Plan CLO-SET Advanced Plan provides full access to all CLO-SET features. Some of the key features (that are not included under Free plan) include but are not limited to: Up to 3GB Rendering per user Web Tech Pack / Excel Tech Pack Virtual Fitting / Virtual Showroom Open API Find more on Free vs. Advanced Plan features. Find the full list of available features under Advanced Plan. How much would it cost for my team? Advanced Plan is $50 per 30 days for each paying user within your Group Paying User: Admin, Collaborator, and Editors Non-Paying User: anyone with Viewer access is free-of-charge If you are collaborating with external partners, inviting them to your Group will be cause additional charges on your billing. Find more on CLO-SET Permission Find more on how CLO-SET billing works 3) 30-day Trial All new users may use a 30-day Trial to explore the Advanced Plan features. NO COMMITMENT - we do NOT collect your payment info or charge you at the end of the Trial. Find more on Advanced Plan benefits that you can enjoy during the Trial period. Find more on what happens after the Trial ends. 4) Free Plan Once your Trial period ends, your Group will be automatically downgraded to Free Plan. CLO-SET Free Plan offers: unlimited storage space Rendering (up to 1 GB per user) real-time communication via online There are several limitations on available features under Free Plan. Find more details here. 5) Enterprise Plan Enterprise Plan is recommended for businesses looking for a more advanced security measurements and physically isolate the data. Checklist for Enterprise Plan. Does your business need any of the following? Independent databases &amp Web servers (physically separate) Dedicated Rendering server for unlimited rendering Authentication via SSO (Single Sign-on) For Enterprise Plan subscription, please contact hello@clo-set.com

Title: Activity Log (Rendering Log)
Content: Permission: Group Admin, Group Operator Objective Access Admin Console by clicking icon on your CLO-SET dashboard. Admin Console shows the Group summary, Billing, Statistics, Activity Log, Settings, and Developer Page. On the Activity Log tab, you may review details on your group's Rendering usage. Rendering Log Details 1) Rendering Log 1. Select the measurement period you want to view. 2. You can search specific members with their registered name or email to view their usage. 3. Click on the field to sort - from highest or from lowest. The field you've chosen will be shown in skyblue. 4. View the Style, Rendering Usage, and Render Setting information for your group. About Rendering usage Rendering usage for the advanced plan is 3GB per user, and the offered usage is aggregated within the group. For the Free plan, there is a 1GB limit, and no additional usage is available.

Title: Permission
Content: Objective The following is the permission hierarchy of CLO-SET. Users can be given any one of the following access rights, in descending order of access: Admin &amp Collaborator Editor &amp Viewer Group Operator Updates on Editor/Viewer (Dec 2023) Setup Guide - find PDF guide at the end of the article To view permission by space and functionality, please refer to Permission Table by Space Details 1) Admin &amp Collaborator Permission Admin Collaborator Space Group, Company, Brand Company, Brand Granted by Invited by Admin Payment Paying user type Access Can create/edit/delete Spaces &amp Styles. Can invite Collaborators and share to Editors/Viewers. Can ONLY create/edit/delete Season(Line) and below. Can share the workroom &amp Company Library to Editors/Viewers. Description Group Admin: All access. Can create/edit/delete all Spaces and invite users to any level of Space. Subject to payment for the entire Group. Company Admin: Can create/edit/delete Company and below. Invite users to the Company. Brand Admin: Can create/edit/delete Brand and below. Invite users to the Brand. Title: Assortment
Content: Objective 'Assortment' is a Space level for assortment planning &amp final review. You can also create Virtual Fitting viewers and Virtual Showroom, as well as Mix &amp Match within Assortment. Create Assortment / Add Contents Viewing Modes Excel Download Virtual Fitting Virtual Showroom Mix &amp Match Details 1) Create Assortment / Add Contents Create Assortment Create Assortment in Season page 1. Click icon on the top of the Season page. 2. Enter Assortment name and click 'CONFIRM' button. Add Style to Assortment in Workroom page 1. Put the mouse cursor on the desired Style and click theicon. 2. Click 'Add to Assortment'. Add Style to Assortment in Assortment page 1. Click icon and select the desired style to add into Assortment. 2. Select the desired style from EXPLORER or add the style you recently worked on from RECENT. 2) Viewing Modes Viewer Mode Drop Down Menu Quickly switch the viewer option between 2D, 3D, and Render. Hover over the style in Assortment Room, and you will see a drop-down menu on the upper right corner. Click to switch viewer modes! By Viewer Mode 2D 3D Render *When viewing in Render mode, selecting a colorway OUTSIDE the viewer will NOT be reflected. *Colorway list is from the original Zprj file. New colorway added from CLO-SET Configurator will not show. To add new colorways, upload a new Zprj file, and move the garment to Assortment room. Synchronized Camera in Assortment Synchronized Camera in Assortment, by allowing users to add multiple Contents in Assortment and view them at the same time with the customized multiview. Select the desired 3D contents and activate 3D Viewers by clicking the 'Viewer' button in the 3D window. When the 3D viewer has been activated, turn on the Synchronized Camera mode by clicking the 'Synchronized' button on the top of the 3D contents. Now, you can review and control multiple 3D contents with the customized multiview at the same time. Note: In accordance with the release of Synchronized Camera, My bag Function will discontinue its service and be replaced from October 5, 2021. 3) Excel Download You may utilize Excel Download ( ) to export the info of Contents within the Assortment. 4) Virtual Fitting Service (Fitting Conversion) Virtual Fitting allows customers to create an avatar with user-customized body shapes and sizes, try on the garments in real-time and check the fitting. 5) Virtual Showroom You may create a Virtual Showroom using the 3D Contents within your Assortment. Please follow the link to find detailed guidelines on how to set up your Virtual Showroom. 6) Simple Mix &amp Match Mix &amp Match your Contents to review the full style. You can try mixing up the combination to see which designs go well together.

Title: Supported File Formats in 3D Viewer
Content: Objective Learn about supported file formats in CLO-SET 3D Viewer. File Format Using 3D Viewer Details 1) File Format Type Format Description Garment *.zpac Contains information on garments, patterns, sewing, and fabrics. Project *.zprj Compressed version of multiple files used for garment creation. The Project file contains the AVT file that has avatar-related data (Avatar, Accessories, Arrangement Bounding Volumes, Arrangement Points, Avatar size, Poses), the ZPac file that contains garment-related data (3D Garments, 2D Patterns, Fabrics, subsidiary Material), as well as an animation file if there is any. Avatar *.avt, .avte Contains all the information related to Avatars (Model, Sizing data, Poses, Motions, Accessories, Bounding Volumes, Arrangement Points). OBJ *.obj Contains geometry and material information. Primarily used for importing avatar and related sources into the program. FBX *.fbx Contains mesh, material, joint, animation, and camera information. GL Transmission Format *gltf / glb Contains scene and material information using the JSON standard. Primarily used for importing avatar and related sources into the program. COLLADA *.dae This file can be exported from other 3D softwares such as 3ds Max, Maya, Pose, and DAZ Studio. These files contain geometry and material information, as well as rigging, skinning, and animation data When exporting COLLADA files from 3ds Max or Maya, install OpenCOLLADA plugin (http://www.opencollada.org/download.html) and export to use the avatar Fabric *.zfab Contains the property values (texture + physical properties) of the set fabric. Button *.btn Contains the type, size, and color of Buttons. Buttonhole *.bth Contains the type, size, and color of the Buttonholes. Trim *.trm Contains material information Zipper Puller *.zpl Contains the type, size, and color of Zipper Pullers. Zipper Slider *.zsd Contains the type, size, and color of Zipper Sliders. Zipper Stopper *.zsp Contains the type, size, and color of Zipper Stoppers. 2) Using 3D Viewer For more instructions on how to use CLO-SET 3D Viewer, click HERE.
